name: imap-mcp-pro
description: Production-grade IMAP & SMTP integration for Claude Desktop. Connect any IMAP account, search and triage at scale, send messages with attachments, and run spam/domain checks via the UserCheck integration.
long_description:
IMAP MCP Pro turns Claude Desktop into a full-featured email client. It connects to any standard IMAP server (Gmail, Outlook, Fastmail, iCloud, Dovecot, etc.), supports multiple accounts per user, and exposes 100+ tools for searching, reading, sending, organizing, and analyzing email — including bulk operations on tens of thousands of messages without blowing your token budget thanks to the resource-handle response system.

Key capabilities:
- Multi-account IMAP via secure encrypted credential storage (AES-256-GCM)
- Send mail through SMTP with backward-compatible attachment handling
- Bulk search/move/copy/delete with auto-chunking and worker-pool parsing
- Find and clean up large messages by size; export messages and attachments locally as .eml; report mailbox quota
- Three-tier response (inline / handle / file-backed) keeps results small
- UserCheck integration for spam-sender detection
- DNS firewall checks for outbound link safety
- 100+ MCP tools — every IMAP4rev2 (RFC 9051) operation we use is implemented

This extension installs a self-contained Node runtime. Credentials are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM using a file-based key (stored at ~/.imap-mcp/.encryption-key, mode 600) — no native OS-keyring dependency.

database_path.title: Data Directory
database_path.description: Where IMAP MCP Pro stores its SQLite database, staged uploads, and result cache. Choose a writable location.

encryption_key.title: Encryption Key (optional)
encryption_key.description: Master key for credential storage. Leave blank to auto-generate a file-based key (~/.imap-mcp/.encryption-key, mode 600); credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Set a value only to supply your own key.

allowed_attachment_dirs.title: Allowed Attachment Directories
allowed_attachment_dirs.description: Directories the server may read attachments from for path-based attachment sends. Add only directories that contain files you want to send. Empty list disables the feature.

allowed_export_dirs.title: Allowed Export Directories
allowed_export_dirs.description: Directories the export tools may write .eml files DIRECTLY into via destPath (e.g. your Downloads folder). Leave empty to allow anywhere in your home directory (never inside the server's own data dir). Set specific directories to restrict, or a nonexistent path to disable direct export entirely.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Server log verbosity. One of: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR. Logs are captured by Claude Desktop at ~/Library/Logs/Claude/mcp-server-imap-mcp-pro.log (macOS) or %APPDATA%\Claude\logs\ (Windows).

max_attachment_size_bytes.title: Maximum Attachment Size — per file (bytes)
max_attachment_size_bytes.description: Reject any single attachment larger than this value, in bytes. Applies uniformly to inline (base64-in-JSON), path-based, and staged attachment forms. Default 20 MiB (20971520). Range: 1 MiB to 100 MiB.

max_total_attachment_size_bytes.title: Maximum Attachment Size — aggregate per send (bytes)
max_total_attachment_size_bytes.description: Reject a send whose attachments collectively exceed this value, in bytes. The budget spans all forms (inline + path + staged) in a single send. Default 20 MiB (20971520). Range: 1 MiB to 200 MiB. Most SMTP providers reject messages over 25–35 MiB; staying near the per-file cap is recommended.

allow_dotfiles.title: Allow Dotfile / Dotdir Attachments
allow_dotfiles.description: When false (default and recommended), the server refuses to attach any file whose path or filename has a segment starting with '.' (.ssh, .aws, .config, .bashrc, .envrc, etc.). Most dotfile-prefixed paths are OS or app secrets and should never leave the host as an email attachment. Set to true only if you have a legitimate workflow that emails a dotfile.

auto_create_sent_folder.title: Auto-Create Sent Folder
auto_create_sent_folder.description: Create a Sent folder automatically if one cannot be detected via RFC 6154 SPECIAL-USE.

mcp_user_id.title: User ID
mcp_user_id.description: Username for tool-context resolution (multi-tenant deployments). Single-user installs can leave as 'default'.

web_ui_port.title: Web UI Port (preferred)
web_ui_port.description: Preferred port for the embedded Web UI (account management, DNS firewall, categories, Claude Desktop auto-setup). The server probes this port first; if it is in use, it increments by 100 (e.g. 4500 → 4600 → 4700) up to 10 attempts before giving up. The Web UI binds to 127.0.0.1 only and is never exposed to the network. Default 4500.
